hero.headline: Owning a Frenchie is different from owning any other dog. Nobody told you, right?
hero.intro: The first week with a Frenchie is chaotic. Googling gives you conflicting advice. And your veterinarian has 15 minutes with you.

survival.title: The 7 things nobody told you about Frenchies
items: Their folds need daily cleaning. Without it, they can get infected.
They cannot regulate temperature well. Heat can be dangerous.
They are prone to allergies. Food matters more than with many breeds.
Their ears get infected often if you do not check them weekly.
They can develop disc issues. Intense exercise before age one can hurt.
Snorting and snoring are common, but some sounds are emergencies.
They need more vet visits than most breeds. Get organized from day one.

mistake.title: The most common new-owner mistake
mistake.headline: Not tracking from the beginning.
mistake.body: When your Frenchie is 3 or 5 and a strange symptom appears, puppy history is gold: what they ate, how they breathed, when itching started, which vaccines they had, and what every vet said.
